Emily / team — looping in suggested order-form language below (first pass). I'm including the measurement/tolerance language we typically propose for enterprise exceptions. Happy to adjust once we see the traffic profile.

Proposed SLA addendum (order form language) — FIRST DRAFT:
1) Availability Commitment: Redwood Inference will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide 99.95% availability for the "rpc/text-generation" endpoint measured monthly. Availability is calculated as: 1 - (total unavailable seconds during measurement window / total seconds in measurement window).

2) Latency Commitment: For single-stream requests up to 2048 input tokens and k=1, Redwood will maintain P95 end-to-end service latency <= 300ms when requests originate from the agreed region and subject to stated throughput limits. Latency is measured at the ingress point in Redwood's control plane.

3) Measurement Window & Exclusions: Measurements are calculated on a calendar-month basis. Exclusions: (a) Planned maintenance with >= 72 hours notice; (b) Customer-caused outages (network, misconfiguration, abusive traffic); (c) Force majeure; (d) Platform upgrades that Customer elected to skip (opt-out).

4) Credits: If Redwood fails to meet the Availability Commitment in a given month, Customer will be eligible for a service credit equal to 5% of that month's platform fees for each 0.1% below the commitment, up to a maximum credit of 100% of monthly fees for that month. Credits are applied to future invoices and are Customer's sole remedy.

5) Capacity & Operational Assumptions: This exception is conditional on either (i) Customer provisioning dedicated capacity via Redwood Dedicated (recommended for high QPS), or (ii) Customer agreeing to documented throughput caps for hosted capacity. Without dedicated capacity, availability/latency guarantees are best-effort and limited as specified.

6) Change Control: Any change to endpoints covered or target values must be agreed in writing.

Please treat this as a negotiating starting point. Emily — if you confirm the QPS and whether you're buying Dedicated, we can produce a clean redline and have Legal prep a tracked-change version to attach to the MSA.
